summary: WP-002 backend implementation is correct, well-structured, and consistent with codebase conventions. All 10 ACs confirmed met. Implementation follows established handler patterns throughout.

handleRenameProject: assertSafeSlug → safeParse validation → ledgerDirExists guard → store.updateTitle() — clean and linear. TypeScript narrowing is sound: validationError() returns never, so parseResult.data access after the guard is type-safe. Delegates atomically to LedgerStore.updateTitle() which re-validates via ProjectMetaSchema.parse before atomic write.

handleListProjects: repository_name uses inferProjectRootFromPlanPath then splits on both / and \ with .filter(Boolean) guard — correct cross-platform handling. meta.title priority block placed correctly at the end of project_name derivation, ensuring persisted titles always win.

PATCH route in server.ts: body-parse guard pattern consistent with POST reset handler. ApiError dispatched via apiErrorToStatus. process.stderr.write used correctly for unexpected errors (server.ts is exempt from STDIO discipline). Route placed before POST reset handler — no routing ambiguity.
CORS Access-Control-Allow-Methods correctly includes PATCH.

One minor style inconsistency found: RenameBodySchema defined inline (line 623) while all other schemas in api.ts (GuiConfigPartialSchema L502, WpDecisionSchema L533, ResetRequestSchema L538) are module-level consts. Not a blocker, but diverges from the established pattern and adds a minor allocation overhead per call.

comments.note: RenameBodySchema (api.ts line 623) is defined inline inside handleRenameProject. Every other schema in api.ts (GuiConfigPartialSchema, WpDecisionSchema, ResetRequestSchema) is a module-level const. Recommend hoisting to module level to restore consistency and avoid per-call re-instantiation.

The z.string().max(200) cap on the rename title has no accompanying comment explaining the choice. A brief note (e.g. '// matches ProjectMetaSchema title constraint') would help future maintainers understand the bound.

Echoing QA finding: handleRenameProject has zero unit tests. The four paths (happy, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR empty title, path-traversal) should be covered in a follow-up WP. The existing test thoroughness for handleGetProject, handleDeleteProject, and handleGetWorkPackage sets the standard.
